_comment: Realtime Database security rules for the Iron Protocol battle tracker.
Paste these into Firebase Console -> Realtime Database -> Rules.
Access is by knowledge of the 4-character room code alone: anyone who has the
code can read and write that battle. That is appropriate here — a battle
document holds nothing sensitive, and the two players are sitting at the same
table — but be aware it is not authentication. Anyone who guesses a code can
edit that battle, and codes are short.
What these rules do enforce: writes are confined to /battles/<CODE>, codes must
look like room codes, a battle must carry the fields the app expects, and
